sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXIII OF 2001
ORDINANCE
XXIII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
PROHIBITION OF SMOKING IN CINEMA
HOUSES
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
An
Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Prohibition
of
Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
22nd
September, 2001]
No. Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV,
dated 22‑9‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 18th September, 2001 is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short
title and commencement.‑‑-(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It
shall come into force On the 14th day of August, 2001.
